title: Quantifying the effect of noise perturbation for the stochastic Burgers equation with additive trace-class noise
summary: We establish upper bounds for the weak and strong error resulting from a perturbation of the noise driving the stochastic Burgers equation, where we assume the noise to be additive and of trace class and the initial value to be sufficiently regular.
